book.name: MATTA
book.title: Matta Laɓara na Mbǝnggǝn aten Yeeso

content: Tsahad chichiiya ha
Tǝrgha fingya Farisaya tǝ famalǝmngya ngyakhrha thliigha ɓa a Urshalima tsahang mee nda Yeeso,
“Kama na fatsahayiwa hwasang ǝntin shingginǝm? Mba nda tsaɓang haryi ndan ɗǝ a hǝb ǝnnarhami nda wa!”
Nggǝrangga Yeeso kanda sǝ, “Kama nun hwasang nda ǝngya ndaana Faara ka ǝntinggi nun?
Ƙǝsǝr ndagha Faara, ‘Fǝrang mamnggirha nda muwa tǝ tsu’ tǝ ƙǝm ‘Kala niifa sargha man nduwa chin tǝtani a ɓǝlang ngganda.’
Amma nun tsaharha ha tǝ ndaarha ana ˈya sǝ a haar niifa na a ɗanggǝn chin sǝ nduwa man, nǝn ndaarha ‘ˈya nun a kya waala a fanna ɗǝfang ɗi ndǝn Faara ɗǝ.’
Ahu kwamana kiya Mǝmǝlwa a fǝrang mamnggirha nǝn fa nggǝtyighǝn tǝghǝn wa. Nanǝn kee kar laɓar ɗanun fa ndaana Faara ka ǝntin nun.
Kun fathǝrɓuya! Laɓar Faara ndaana Ishaya aten nun mǝmǝlni:

content.text: ‘Nafiniya ahu mii ndan ni kee na nda fǝre mamnggirha,
amma huryi ndan nǝghǝn inggun ma nggi;
ka ni kee na nda ɗǝfee shilee teena,
ƙǝsǝr ɗǝfang ngganda tsahad ngyakhkya fiya ha a mbee a meyed laɓar Faara.’ ”

content: Əngya na tsawang nda niifa ɗimi a mbed Faara
Tǝrgha aagha Yeeso nafini wumngga hai a thlǝmadghǝn ɓa ndǝghǝn, “Keema thlǝmaarha fa tǝnun sǝn ǝnɗi niya thlǝkrha.
ˈYa kyagha hur niifa hai mbǝ ndǝna tsawang tǝ ‘paarha’ fa wa, amma ƙǝl ˈya na a kyarha ɓa a miighǝn ndǝna tsawang tǝ ‘paarha’ fa.”
Tǝrgha fatsahayini ɓa nda thlǝmadghǝn ɓa tsahang mee nda, “Sǝnna sǝ sǝb hur Farisayina ɗǝ sǝk nanda laɓarɗi?”
Nggǝrangga Yeeso kanda sǝ, “Kala hǝfrha a mbǝ pǝpa na a talara hǝfgha ndǝn wa, na nda a ƙǝɗang ɗǝ tǝ thlarghǝn.
Malaman kanda. Na nda ƙǝla mangya kwamaya na nda a ƙǝs sǝsal kwamaya. Ana kwamarha a ƙǝs sǝsal kwamarha, kanda kyab na nda a mukrha hu kwaarha hai.”
Ndangga Mbiturus Yeeso, “Pǝrang ten karapuɗi kan ya.”
Tsahangga Yeeso mee kanda, “Ɓal wun kula sǝnang hai wa?
Kala ˈya ǝnana niifa mii nǝn kyarha hurghǝn ɗǝ nggǝrghǝn kyarha sǝ a fadghǝn.
Amma ǝnɗi na a kyarha ɓa ahu mee, kyaghǝn sǝ ahur niifa. Ndǝghǝnni na tsawang nda niifa tǝ ‘paarha’ fa.
Ƙǝsǝr ahur niifa sǝ ndǝna numad mbǝlfeerha kyarha ɓa, tǝ ɓǝl farha, tǝ kulafayirha, tǝ pateyirha, tǝ ngaara, tǝ ƙǝnang paama nggaɓaarha mu tǝ sǝb thlǝma.
Əngginiya ndǝna tsawang niifa tǝ paarha fa a mbed Faara, amma hǝb ǝnnarhami kula tsab haara mbǝ ndǝna tsawang niifa tǝ paarha fa a mbed Faara wa.”
Fǝrƙǝkafekkid nuneefa tǝ kanˈaniyarha
Tǝrgha Malgha Yeeso Nggalili ɗǝgha hu chehweed Taya ɗǝ tǝ Sidon.
Na nuneefa sǝ tǝ Kanˈana ɓagha thlǝmadghǝn ɓa hwanggǝnǝn, “A haɗoyi fa Chinǝm, Wan Ndauda, ƙǝsǝr wutarad na nǝghǝn tǝ ǝnkaheerha fa nǝn naarha sǝsang nda kaan.”
Amma nggǝrang ngwa Yeeso sǝ wa. Tǝrgha ndangga fatsahayighǝn, “Ndang a wiigha, nǝghǝn a ɓilla ƙǝm tǝ hwanda.”
Nggǝrgha Yeeso sǝ, “Thlǝnna nda nggi ɓa ka ɓi ɗang nda chauraya Isǝreela sǝ sahadgha kee.”
Ɓagha nuɗa ɓa ɓǝrgha hai a mbedghǝn nggǝrghǝn hwanggǝn, “Chinǝm ɗeesǝ!”
Nggǝrgha Yeeso sǝ, “Kamngwa tǝranggǝm ǝnnadmid wundakhnaya fǝranggǝnǝm wuɗaya wa.”
Nggǝrangga nuɗa sǝ, “Ƙǝkafek ni Chinǝm, amma ko wuɗaya ni na nda hǝb fǝfǝsǝrra ǝnnarhami hǝrgha hai a mbǝd ɗauyad turi ndan.”
Tǝrgha nggǝrangga Yeeso sǝ, “Sa nuneefa na fǝrƙǝkafekkid wa manggǝn kaan, ˈya na midwa wal nan.” Tsu kee ƙǝngga wutaradɗi keeghǝn.
Ƙǝnang Yeeso nafiya hangga
Malgha Yeeso mbǝɗi ɗǝgha wuri aam Nggalili ɗǝ tǝrgha wumnda sǝ tsauka hai.

Wumngga fiya thlǝmadghǝn ɓa hangga. Ɓa nda ɓa tǝ sǝfǝngya, tǝ kwamaya, tǝ fingya mǝrna fandan hai, tǝ fingya mbuwa mbang kaala sǝ tǝ fingya haaya hangga. Ɗǝfang ngganda kanda hai a mbed Yeeso, ƙǝnanggǝn kanda heu.

Ƙǝsangga ǝnwulteena fiya wumngga hai na nanda fingyayini mbuwa mbang kaala sǝ kanda a kaala sǝ, fingya mǝrna fandan hai wal nda ƙǝnda, sǝfǝngya a wiirha hai tǝ ƙǝm kwamaya a na maana hai. Na nda a fal Faara yi Isǝreela.
Hǝɓang Yeeso nafiya haru kumnggit faɗa

Tǝrgha aagha Yeeso fatsahayighǝn ɓa ndanggǝn kanda, “Na nafini a haɗee fa ya. Ɓeena mahan kanda a thlǝmadna a mbǝɗiya, tahang ngwa ˈya kanda ha na a ǝna nda mii wa. Mbǝ minna sǝ kal kanda ni hai wii nda wureɗǝ a miirha wa, asǝmha ɗǝgha shiwid kanda teena a kwamana.”
Nggǝrangga fatsahayighǝn sǝ, “A yanggi ɗǝnǝm wal mburodi ɓa a kahedɗi ya na a tsǝghanggǝn fiya hangga kiya?”
Tsahangga Yeeso mee kanda, “Mburodi kurmi ni a har nun?” Ndang ngganda, “Mǝd tǝ tǝngya na miɗiɗi ngguchit.”
Ndangga Yeeso fiya wumngga hai a tsawa nda hai a hweeɗe.
Tǝrgha haranggǝn mburodi yina sǝ mǝd tǝ tǝnggini, usa nǝn Faara, kyanggǝn hai kutelth-kutelth. Fǝranggǝnǝn fatsahayighǝn ndǝghang nggǝnda fiya ɗǝ.
Kanda heu kii nda nggaala nda. Wumangga fatsahayini katǝbghǝn kutasya mǝd.
Nafiya hǝbgha ǝnnadɗami hǝshya haru kumnggit faɗa kula thlǝɗang nda nishya tǝ wundakhnaya.
Akwasamadɗi kalna Yeeso fiya hai, kyagha ahu kombuwol hai ɗǝgha chehweed Manggadan ɗǝ.
